title.en: France after the demarcation line took effect (1940-07-15)

asOfNote.zh-Hant: Leconte 分界線圖印行於 1940–1943，畫的是分界線本身，不是當日快照；取 7 月中德軍退回分界線後的狀態。
asOfNote.en: The Leconte map (printed 1940–43) shows the line itself, not a dated snapshot; taken as the situation after German forces withdrew to the line in mid-July.
